markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (>99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds only Invasive; second model and all 5 similar cases agree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99%, InSitu <1% | Strongly peaked |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 88th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical; strongest here [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 2, 9) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical; spot check 18/20 · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 1, 2, 9) · context · 100th percentile; mean nuclear area 0th [F8] · Measured
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Scored high; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 deletion drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Necrosis and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 11 is in situ or benign; its regional invasive probability is only 49%.
- Nuclear measurements cover regions 1, 2, 9 only; mean nuclear area is 0th percentile.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 9** — confirm tumor infiltrating stroma.
2. **Region 11** — lowest regional invasive score (49%); check in situ versus invasive.
3. **Region 10** — inferior margin tumor score 6%, others ≥98%; recheck margin call [F10].
